chain_txs_confirmed_signature.name: chain_txs_confirmed_signature
chain_txs_confirmed_signature.value: status <> 'confirmed' OR (signature IS NOT NULL AND confirmed_at IS NOT NULL)

disputes_share_range.name: disputes_share_range
disputes_share_range.value: seller_share_bps IS NULL OR seller_share_bps BETWEEN 0 AND 10000

disputes_resolution_complete.name: disputes_resolution_complete
disputes_resolution_complete.value: state <> 'resolved' OR (seller_share_bps IS NOT NULL AND decision IS NOT NULL AND resolved_by IS NOT NULL)

listings_fee_policy.name: listings_fee_policy
listings_fee_policy.value:
fee_bps IS NULL OR (
        fee_bps BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND
        CASE WHEN mode = 'fixed'
          THEN uplift_fee_bps = 0 AND max_fee_bps = fee_bps
          ELSE fee_bps <= max_fee_bps AND max_fee_bps <= uplift_fee_bps AND uplift_fee_bps <= 10000
        END)

listings_reviewed_fees.name: listings_reviewed_fees
listings_reviewed_fees.value: state IN ('draft', 'in_review', 'changes_requested', 'rejected') OR fee_bps IS NOT NULL

listings_published_chain.name: listings_published_chain
listings_published_chain.value: state NOT IN ('published', 'closed') OR chain_address IS NOT NULL

spots_holder_matches_state.name: spots_holder_matches_state
spots_holder_matches_state.value:
(state IN ('open', 'cancelled') AND buyer_id IS NULL AND amount IS NULL)
        OR (state NOT IN ('open', 'cancelled') AND buyer_id IS NOT NULL AND buyer_wallet IS NOT NULL AND amount >= price)

spots_proof_before_delivered.name: spots_proof_before_delivered
spots_proof_before_delivered.value: state <> 'delivered' OR proof_submitted_at IS NOT NULL
